evidence.quote: Must have platinum-refractory disease defined as disease progression during or ≤ 29 weeks after completion of definitive therapy (chemoradiation therapy) or adjuvant (post-operative) therapy.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2.
Histologically confirmed diagnosis head and neck squamous cell carcinomas (HNSCC).

labels.note: Needs platinum-refractory R/M HNSCC; he is newly diagnosed and untreated, and mostly in a recliner or bed (ECOG 3-4).

labels.note: Radioprotector with definitive cisplatin-RT; histology, primary and plan are unknown, but ECOG 3-4 fails Zubrod 0-2.
